features.name: scaled_center_l2_distance
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from the row to the fixed training-fold numeric center across buying, maint, doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a balanced global radial coordinate so distance KNN does not overemphasize higher-range fields.

features.name: cost_subspace_l2_distance
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from the buying and maint pair to its fixed training-fold center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates ownership-cost code neighborhoods while keeping both cost fields on comparable scale.

features.name: utility_subspace_l2_distance
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety to their fixed training-fold center.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact usability and safety radius that improves local geometry among practical-utility fields.

features.name: low_index_cost_upper_index_utility_corner_distance
features.description: Range-normalized distance to the generic corner with lower buying and maint codes and upper doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a prototype coordinate around an interpretable cost-utility corner, improving neighbor ordering for rows near that pattern.

features.name: high_index_cost_lower_index_utility_corner_distance
features.description: Range-normalized distance to the opposite generic corner with upper buying and maint codes and lower doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a complementary prototype coordinate so KNN can distinguish opposite ordinal-code regions smoothly.

features.name: cost_utility_contrast
features.description: Signed difference between the average normalized buying and maint code level and the average normalized utility-code level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses broad trade-off movement into one axis, improving distance ordering for rows with similar balance patterns.

features.name: cost_pair_similarity
features.description: Similarity score for alignment between buying and maint code levels, with 1 meaning identical codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps rows with coordinated purchase and upkeep codes closer in similarity space.

features.name: utility_coherence_similarity
features.description: Similarity score measuring coherence among normalized doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety code levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Rewards rows whose capacity, storage, and safety code levels move together, reducing jagged ordinal effects.

features.name: capacity_safety_constraint_indicator
features.description: Binary marker for rows with the minimum passenger-capacity code or the minimum safety code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a crisp boundary for rows with minimum capacity or safety cues, which can benefit neighborhood separation in ordinal-coded data.

features.name: low_index_cost_upper_index_utility_cluster_indicator
features.description: Binary marker for the compact corner with buying and maint codes at most 1, doors at least 2, and persons, lug_boot, and safety at their upper code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a high-similarity island for rows sharing a coherent ordinal-code configuration.

features.name: semantic_practical_use_score
features.description: A 0-to-1 row-level semantic judgment, using only doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety, of practical-use strength inferred from their ordinal code positions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth domain-aware coordinate that can pull semantically similar rows together for distance KNN.

features.name: semantic_cost_utility_fit_score
features.description: A 0-to-1 row-level semantic judgment, using buying, maint, doors, persons, lug_boot, and safety, of whether cost-related codes appear well matched to utility and safety codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps neighborhoods reflect perceived value balance beyond raw ordinal gaps.
